browser_choice.reason: The user explicitly selected the project-isolated Chrome DevTools MCP because the default Playwright MCP was not configured for extension install/action control.

steps: Installed the production WXT build with Chrome DevTools MCP install_extension.
Listed installed extensions and service worker.
scenarios.expected: 广告净化 v0.1.0 is enabled as an unpacked extension.
scenarios.actual: Extension ooadlcdjhdoaanegcfieeidedohkbnjg listed as 广告净化 v0.1.0 Enabled with its service worker.

steps: Triggered the installed extension action by ID.
Waited for and inspected the created extension popup page.
scenarios.expected: The native action opens the popup and identifies the actual HTTP page.
scenarios.actual: Popup opened from native action, showed 保护已开启 and current page 127.0.0.1 after the target-tab regression fix.

steps: Loaded a local page with a legitimate local image and a googlesyndication subresource.
Turned the master switch off in the real popup and reloaded.
Turned it on again and reloaded.
scenarios.expected: Only the known advertising subresource is blocked while enabled; it is not extension-blocked while disabled; local resources remain available.
scenarios.actual: Enabled: ad request net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT and local image 200. Disabled: same ad URL reached the server and returned 404, local image remained 200. Re-enabled: blocked again.

steps: Turned protection off in the popup.
Triggered the installed extension action again.
scenarios.expected: The master setting remains off when the native popup is closed and reopened.
scenarios.actual: Reopened popup showed 保护已暂停, an unchecked switch, current page 127.0.0.1, and page hidden count 0.
